<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#f5f7fc; --bg-alt:#eef1fa; --surface:#ffffff; --ink:#10152b; --ink-soft:#5c6478; --line:#e1e5f2;
    --indigo:#4f46e5; --indigo-dark:#3c34b5; --indigo-bg:#edeafe;
    --blue:#2563eb; --blue-bg:#e7f0fe;
    --cyan:#0891b2; --cyan-bg:#e1f6fb;
    --violet:#7c3aed; --violet-bg:#f2ecfe;
    --pink:#db2777; --pink-bg:#fde7f2;
    --mint:#0d9488; --mint-bg:#dff5f1;
    --amber:#d97706; --amber-bg:#fdf0dc;
    --red:#dc2626; --red-bg:#fde8e8;
    --gray:#6b7280; --gray-bg:#eef0f4;
    --radius:16px; --maxw:none;
  }
  .wsw *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  .wsw{font-family:"Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--surface);line-height:1.55;}
  .wsw img,.wsw svg{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  .wsw a{color:inherit;}
  .wsw .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(24px,4vw,96px);}
  .wsw h1,.wsw h2,.wsw h3,.wsw h4{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;line-height:1.12;margin:0 0 .5em;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.02em;}
  .wsw h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,4.6vw,3.55rem);}
  .wsw h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.6vw,2.6rem);}
  .wsw h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:.5em;}
  .wsw h4{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:.3em;}
  .wsw p{margin:0 0 1em;}
  .wsw section{padding:84px 0;}
  .wsw .section-white{background:var(--surface);}
  .wsw .section-tint{background:var(--bg-alt);}
  .wsw .section-dark{background:var(--ink);color:#e7e9f5;}
  .wsw .section-dark h2,.wsw .section-dark h3{color:#fff;}
  .wsw .section-gradient{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#3730a3 0%,#4f46e5 45%,#0891b2 100%);color:#fff;}
  .wsw .section-gradient h2{color:#fff;}
  .wsw .section-pricing{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eef0fe 0%,#e5f6fb 100%);}
  .wsw .lede{font-size:1.13rem;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:620px;margin-bottom:1.5em;}
  .wsw .section-dark .lede{color:#b6bcd8;}
  .wsw .section-gradient .lede{color:#e4e8ff;}
  .wsw .center{text-align:center;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .wsw .eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:clamp(.92rem,1.5vw,1.02rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:18px;}
  .wsw .section-gradient .eyebrow{color:#c7d2fe;}
  .wsw .head-center{text-align:center;max-width:740px;margin:0 auto 46px;}
  .wsw .head-center .lede{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}
  .wsw .color-strip{height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--indigo),var(--blue),var(--cyan),var(--violet),var(--pink));}
  .wsw code{font-family:ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,monospace;}
  /* Buttons */
  .wsw .btn{display:inline-block;padding:16px 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;font-size:.98rem;border:1.5px solid transparent;transition:transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;}
  .wsw .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .wsw .btn-primary{background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(79,70,229,.28);}
  .wsw .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--indigo-dark);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(79,70,229,.34);}
  .wsw .btn-outline{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--ink);}
  .wsw .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--indigo);color:var(--indigo);}
  .wsw .cta-note{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;}
  .wsw .section-gradient .btn-primary,.wsw .final-cta .btn-primary,.wsw .section-pricing .price-card .btn-primary{background:#fff;color:var(--indigo);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(16,21,43,.22);}
  .wsw .section-gradient .btn-primary:hover,.wsw .final-cta .btn-primary:hover{background:#f2f4ff;}
  .wsw .cta-link{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--indigo);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--indigo-bg);text-underline-offset:3px;}
  .wsw .cta-link:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--indigo);}
  .wsw .section-gradient .cta-link{color:#fff;text-decoration-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);}
  /* Hero */
  .wsw .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:56px 0 60px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eef1fc 0%,var(--surface) 78%);}
  .wsw .hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;}
  .wsw .hero .wrap > div{min-width:0;}
  .wsw .blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.16;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;}
  .wsw .blob-1{width:520px;height:520px;background:var(--blue);top:-240px;right:-180px;}
  .wsw .tagline{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-style:italic;color:#0a6a79;font-size:1.05rem;margin:2px 0 16px;}
  .wsw .hero-actions{margin-top:26px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:center;}
  .wsw .trust-line{margin-top:22px;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;}
  .wsw .trust-line b{color:var(--ink);}
  .wsw .trust-line span{margin:0 4px;color:var(--line);}
  .wsw .hero-visual{display:flex;justify-content:center;}
  /* ===== wb-embed: scoped, screen-adapted reproduction of the real workbook design system (workbook.css) ===== */
  .wb-embed{
    --radius:14px;
    font-family:"Inter",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; line-height:1.55; font-size:10.6pt; color:var(--ink);
  }
  .wb-embed h1,.wb-embed h2,.wb-embed h3,.wb-embed h4{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 .4em;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  .wb-embed p{margin:0 0 .85em;}
  .wb-embed strong{color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed em{color:inherit;}
  .wb-embed a{color:var(--blue);}
  .wb-embed .content-wrap{max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.2pt;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow.indigo{color:var(--indigo);background:var(--indigo-bg);}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow.cyan{color:var(--cyan);background:var(--cyan-bg);}
  .wb-embed .eyebrow.violet{color:var(--violet);background:var(--violet-bg);}
  .wb-embed .rhythm{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8pt;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:20px 0 8px;}
  .wb-embed .callout{border-left:4px solid var(--indigo);background:var(--indigo-bg);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;padding:12px 16px;margin:14px 0;}
  .wb-embed .callout .cl-label{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.4pt;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .wb-embed .callout p{font-size:9.6pt;margin:0;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed .callout.mint{border-color:var(--mint);background:var(--mint-bg);} .wb-embed .callout.mint .cl-label{color:var(--mint);}
  .wb-embed .worksheet{border:1.4px solid var(--indigo);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;margin:0;}
  .wb-embed .ws-bar{background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;padding:9px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.4pt;letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .wb-embed .ws-body{padding:16px 22px 6px;background:var(--surface);}
  .wb-embed .ws-group{font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.6pt;color:var(--indigo-dark);margin:14px 0 8px;}
  .wb-embed .ws-group:first-child{margin-top:0;}
  .wb-embed .ws-item{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:9px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:9.4pt;}
  .wb-embed .ws-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .wb-embed .chk{flex:0 0 auto;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink-soft);margin-top:2px;}
  .wb-embed .field-label{font-family:"Inter";font-weight:600;font-size:9.4pt;color:var(--ink);margin:8px 0 3px;}
  .wb-embed .field-blank{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);min-height:18px;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .wb-embed .askai{border-left:4px solid var(--violet);background:var(--violet-bg);border-radius:0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0;padding:14px 18px;margin:0;}
  .wb-embed .askai .ai-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:8.6pt;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--violet);margin-bottom:9px;}
  .wb-embed .prompt-card{background:#fff;border:1.4px dashed #c9b8f5;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 15px;font-size:9.4pt;color:var(--ink);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .wb-embed .prompt-label{font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:700;font-size:8.6pt;color:var(--violet);text-transform:none;font-style:normal;margin-bottom:4px;display:block;}
  .wb-embed .ai-guard{font-size:8.8pt;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0;}
  .wb-embed table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:12px 0 18px;font-size:9pt;max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed table th{background:var(--bg-alt);text-align:left;font-family:"Inter";font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:7.4pt;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);}
  .wb-embed table td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:top;color:var(--ink);}
  .wb-embed table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
  .wb-embed .triage-group{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .wb-embed .triage-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:"Manrope",sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:9.4pt;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;margin-bottom:7px;padding-bottom:5px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);}
  .wb-embed .dot-lg{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .wb-embed .triage-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:5px 0;font-size:9.4pt;}
  .wb-embed table.rmap{font-size:8.8pt;}
  .wb-embed .week-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--indigo);color:#fff;font-family:"Manrope";font-weight:800;font-size:9pt;}
  .wb-embed .effort{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:5px;}
  .wb-embed .effort span{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line);}
  .wb-embed .eff-quick span:nth-child(1){background:var(--mint);}
  .wb-embed .eff-mod span:nth-child(1),.wb-embed .eff-mod span:nth-child(2){background:var(--amber);}
  .wb-embed .eff-sub span{background:var(--red);}
  .wb-embed .sec-pill{display:inline-block;background:var(--gray-bg);color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:700;font-size:7.4pt;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 8px;margin:1px 2px 0 0;}
  .wb-embed figure.diagram{margin:0;max-width:100%;}
  .wb-embed figure.diagram svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}
  .wb-embed figcaption{font-size:8.6pt;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:10px;}

  .wb-embed .c2-h1 .accent{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#bcd7ff,#a6f3e6);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;}
